rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE or board-approved CPE (1.5 units = 15 hours)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Waived for pharmacists licensed by examination who renew for the first time in the same calendar year (not for reinstatement).
rules.alternatives: Voluntary inactive, gold voluntary inactive and military pharmacists are waived from CPE.
rules.audit_note: Online renewal pauses for an automated CPE Monitor check; renewal cannot be completed until CPE Monitor shows compliance.
rules.notes: Annual renewal Nov 1-Dec 31. At least 3 of 15 hours must be live; otherwise 20 hours in total. CPE must be recorded in NABP CPE Monitor with the Louisiana license number. Full rule text (doa.la.gov) was blocked, so topics are not checked.
rules.legal_basis: La. Admin. Code tit. 46, pt. LIII, §507
